name: The egg stirs

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

summary: After the avatar is defeated, its essence is placed within the Ancient Egg. Yeh'kinya says he will keep the vessel safe, yet the quest's closing unease leaves the matter unsettled: the egg stirs. A containment ritual has reached its stated end, but the story does not grant the seeker proof that the danger has passed.
